name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: HarnessSafe: Evaluating Safety Across Persistent Carriers in Agent Harnesses
items.dek: HarnessSafe benchmark reveals 328 attack chains across seven persistent-carrier families in agent harnesses; containment is carrier and configuration-specific.
items.unproven: does not establish baseline safety metrics for production agents or how constraints map to real-world deployment trade-offs

items.title: SynChain: Inducing Computer-Use Agent Systems to Construct Their Own Attack Chains
items.dek: Computer-use agents can be fine-tuned to synthesize poisoned artifacts that survive state updates and reactivate dormant payloads without new external inputs.
items.unproven: attack effectiveness depends on agent architecture choices; generalization across production LLM deployment patterns and memory/artifact systems not established

items.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation
items.dek: Model editing improves secure code generation by 15–25% on seen vulnerabilities but transfers poorly to unseen ones; SafeEdit mitigates functional correctness loss.
items.unproven: evaluation on limited set of LLMs and vulnerability types; generalization to production code generation pipelines and enterprise threat models not validated

items.title: When Context Bites: Detecting RAG Poisoning via Document-Level Attention Collapse
items.dek: D-SCAN detects RAG poisoning by monitoring attention-entropy collapse on poisoned documents, achieving detection even when poisoned outputs show lower perplexity.
items.unproven: does not test whether detection holds across model families, poison types beyond evaluated benchmarks, or integration costs in production RAG systems

items.title: POKEx: Performance analysis of POKE-key exchange and SIDH-variants
items.dek: POKE-based key exchange outperforms post-quantum SIDH variants by 21–65× in NIST security level 1, informing algorithm selection for migration planning.
items.unproven: performance measured on one reference implementation; security analysis independent of NIST evaluation process; production integration cost and side-channel resistance not covered

items.title: Framework discloses data breach via Metabase 0-day
items.dek: Metabase 0-day exploited in Framework customer breach; warrants review of deployment settings.
items.unproven: whether the reader's organization uses Metabase or similar BI tools; remediation timeline

items.title: "Operator, can you hear me?" A Faithful Line into the UNISOC Baseband
items.dek: First faithful re-hosting of UNISOC UDX710 baseband via component-level simulation enables firmware instrumentation and recovery.
items.unproven: does not demonstrate applicability beyond the UDX710 or production impact on supply-chain risk assessment

items.title: SoK: Cryptographic Key Recovery for Cryptoasset Custody and Financial Technologies
items.authors: Francisco Javier Becerra Sanchez et al.
items.dek: Systematization of 77 papers on cryptoasset key recovery defines five recovery archetypes and tradeoff taxonomy.
items.unproven: does not test recovery mechanisms empirically or establish which schema attributes most affect real-world custody decisions

items.title: Soft Redaction of Image Provenance via Zero-Knowledge Proofs
items.dek: Zero-knowledge proofs enable soft redaction of image provenance by replacing sensitive assertions with proximity and biometric-embedding distance proofs.
items.unproven: does not validate C2PA adoption timelines, ecosystem readiness, or overhead impact on production image-signing workflows

items.title: Effects of parental controls in the context of Digital Forensics
items.dek: Microsoft, Google, and Apple parental controls impede evidence acquisition on 15 Windows, Android, and iOS devices; study identifies forensically sound workarounds.
items.unproven: does not test whether identified workarounds persist after OS updates or remain admissible in legal proceedings

items.title: Casting the Net! Revisiting MasterFace Impersonation Attacks
items.dek: MasterFace impersonation attacks amplify false-match rates on commercial face-recognition APIs beyond baseline under realistic decision-only constraints.
items.unproven: does not quantify attack success across API vendors, user populations, or anti-spoofing mitigations deployed in production

items.title: When Coordination Becomes a Threat: Communication Attacks in LLM-Controlled Multi-Robot Systems
items.dek: LLM-controlled multi-robot systems accept malicious commands through compromised inter-robot communication at 96–100% rates across three architectures.
items.unproven: evaluation on simulated tasks with synthetic attack injection; robustness against realistic network conditions, adversarial detection, and production deployment patterns not tested

items.title: Ransomware gangs skip the CEO, head straight for the 40-something IT manager
items.dek: Ransomware operators target mid-level IT staff over executives; social engineering tactic, not technical discovery.
items.unproven: Whether this represents a shift in attacker behavior or reporting bias; no empirical prevalence data across threat intel sources.

items.title: Shopify replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations–and it scaled
items.dek: Shopify migrated inventory reservation logic from Redis to MySQL; architectural choice specific to their scale and schema.
items.unproven: whether the tradeoffs generalize beyond Shopify's specific workload, schema, and operational maturity.

items.title: Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale
items.dek: Databricks cost-management patterns for AI coding tools; establishes vocabulary around token budgets and batching.
items.unproven: applicability beyond Databricks' own infrastructure and use cases; no independent validation of claims

items.title: The web server deployment model breaks at hobby scale
items.dek: Discussion of web server deployment model constraints at small scale.
items.unproven: specific architectural or security implications for the reader's tooling and SDLC process

items.title: Beyond Text Matching: Towards Reference-Free Evaluation for Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering
items.dek: LLM-as-Judge achieves 63% correlation with human judgment on function-name recovery, binary summarization, and decompilation tasks.
items.unproven: does not establish whether correlations hold on out-of-distribution binaries or transfer to real reverse-engineering workflows

items.title: Statistical Analysis of Executability and Program Equivalence in Decompilation for IoT Vulnerability Detection
items.dek: Nine-dimensional decompilation quality metric across structural, behavioral, and semantic dimensions applied to 318 OpenWrt IoT firmware binaries.
items.unproven: does not validate whether the metric predicts real vulnerability-detection miss rates or guides tooling configuration in practice

items.title: Rigid-Covert GNSS Spoofing of UAV Swarms: A Structural Blind Spot, Its Detection Limit, and Absolute-Anchor Defenses
items.dek: UAV swarms using relative-geometry cross-checks cannot detect slow rigid translations in GNSS spoofing attacks, but absolute anchors restore observability.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to synthetic and controlled settings; applicability to real deployed swarms with production GNSS/inertial stacks unclear

items.title: MIFA: An MILP-based Framework for Improving Differential Fault Attacks
items.dek: MILP-based framework reduces fault injections required to break differential-fault-resistant ciphers by optimizing injection bit positions across rounds.
items.unproven: attacks demonstrated on academic cipher designs; applicability to hardened hardware implementations and real-world fault injection conditions not assessed

items.title: An Analysis of Architectural and Operational Dynamics of Phishkits in the Wild
items.dek: Analysis of 1,300 phishkits from 2020–2023 finds 22% lack evasion, most rely on messaging services for data exfiltration.
items.unproven: does not establish how findings apply to phishkit prevalence or attacker behavior outside the collected corpus

items.title: An Exploratory Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Rewriting of Moderate-Complexity Financial Sentences for DisCoCat-Based Sentiment Analysis
items.dek: LLM-assisted sentence rewriting improves quantum NLP circuit efficiency on financial sentiment; niche application with marginal gains.
items.unproven: whether modest accuracy improvements (0.550 vs 0.521) hold on production financial data or generalize beyond sentiment classification

items.title: QMIMO: Circuit Based Quantum MIMO Design with Variational Receiver
items.dek: Quantum circuit receiver for MIMO channels underperforms classical detectors; experimental quantum communications without security implication.
items.unproven: whether trade-offs hold at scale or justify quantum approach for any practical communication task

items.title: Open-source interactive map for the Aug 12 total solar eclipse
items.dek: Interactive eclipse map for August 12 total solar eclipse.

items.title: Amazon Is Creating the Biggest Pollution Source in the Country
items.dek: Environmental policy piece on Amazon's data center footprint; outside application security.
items.unproven: entire item outside reader's remit

noise.title: Show HN: textlog – A quiet, text-only microblogging platform, open-source, no JS
noise.unproven: relevance to application security or secure SDLC

noise.title: Hardware backdoors in some x86 CPUs
noise.dek: Hacker News link post with minimal engagement; no evidence of actual finding.
